After the expiration of thirty (30) days
from the issuance of this Order, all the above-described
articles entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, in the
Philippines, for consumption shall be subject to the rates
of import duty herein prescribed.

Any unwarranted increase in the prices of local
products benefited by those tariff changes may be sufficient
ground for the revocation of such tariff changes.
